description: A multiplex networked agent-based model of mask-wearing behavior diffusion with social influence, information propagation, and policy enforcement. Calibrated on days 0-29 and used to predict days 30-39.

parameters.source: agent_attributes.csv and train_data.csv day 0 if present
parameters.impute_missing: group_median for degrees; Beta-fit for risk_perception if missing

behaviors.name: decide_mask_wearing
behaviors.description: Stochastic adoption/cessation decision each day based on habit, social influence by layer, information receipt, risk/trust, policy, and fatigue.
behaviors.algorithm: For agent i at day t: 1) Compute f_family, f_work, f_comm = masked_fraction among neighbors per layer. 2) Determine received_info flag using info algorithm (possibly lagged by L). 3) Compute logit z = alpha0 + phi*(wear_{t-1}) + gamma_risk*(risk_i - mean_risk) + beta_family*f_family + beta_work*f_work + beta_comm*f_comm + psi_info*received_info_{t-L} + policy_shift(t,i) - fatigue_penalty(i,t). 4) Convert to probability p = 1/(1+exp(-z)). 5) If wear_{t-1}=0, adopt with probability p + innovation_rate; if wear_{t-1}=1, continue with probability p*(1 - de_adoption_rate). Draw Bernoulli to set wear_t.

behaviors.name: interact_with_neighbors
behaviors.description: Layer-weighted daily contacts producing visibility of norms and opportunities for information spread.
behaviors.algorithm: Sample contacts per layer proportionally to layer_contact_frequency_weights times location contact_multipliers; observe neighbor mask states to compute masked fractions; pass exposures to info algorithm.

behaviors.name: receive_and_process_information
behaviors.description: Convert social exposures and media/governance broadcasts into received_info events and update beliefs.
behaviors.algorithm: Compute exposure score s = sum_L w_L * f_L; p_network = 1 - exp(-kappa_info_conversion * s). Media/governance: p_media = pro_mask_reach*pro_mask_effect_size*(1 - misinformation_prevalence) adjusted by trust_authority; p_info = 1 - (1 - p_network)*(1 - exogenous_info_rate)*(1 - p_media). Draw Bernoulli received_info_t ~ Bernoulli(p_info). Update risk_perception and misinformation_belief accordingly.

behaviors.name: update_risk_and_trust
behaviors.description: Belief dynamics influenced by external risk signal and authority/media messages.
behaviors.algorithm: external_risk_t follows mean-reverting random walk around baseline with volatility. risk_i(t) = risk_i(t-1) + risk_perception_update_rate*(external_risk_t - risk_i(t-1)) + trust_update_rate*trust_authority*(received_info_t - misinformation_belief_effect). Clip to [0,1].

behaviors.name: respond_to_policy_and_enforcement
behaviors.description: Mandates alter adoption propensity; inspections can trigger fines and future compliance.
behaviors.algorithm: If policy active (t >= policy_start_day): policy_shift adds to adoption log-odds (recommend small, mandate larger). During time spent at mandated locations, if not wearing, detect with probability enforcement_probability * location.enforcement_strength, constrained by remaining enforcement_budget. If detected: record fine, set short-term compliance boost (e.g., increase phi or force wearing for remainder of day and next day), decrement budget.

behaviors.name: move_between_locations
behaviors.description: Daily schedule across home/work_school/public determines contact context.
behaviors.algorithm: Assign fractions of a day to location types using mix; modulate contacts by contact_multipliers; for non-working/non-student occupations, shift work_school time to public.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Layer-specific normative and informational influence via masked neighbor fractions.
interactions.effect: Updates adoption propensity via beta_family/beta_work/beta_comm and contributes to info exposures.

interactions.name: location_contacts_and_norms
interactions.description: Contacts within shared locations, with visible norms and immediate pressure.
interactions.effect: Adjusts masked neighbor fractions and may temporarily boost compliance at high-policy-strength locations.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Inspections and fines influence future compliance.
interactions.effect: If non-compliant in mandated context, possible fine; increases short-run compliance probability.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Media and governance campaigns shift beliefs and info receipt.
interactions.effect: Modifies received_info probability and updates risk/trust/misinformation beliefs.

interactions.name: innovation_and_dropout
interactions.description: Spontaneous adoption and cessation at low rates.
interactions.effect: With small probabilities, agents adopt or stop wearing independent of social signals.

initialization.network_build: from social_network.json if present; else configuration model per layer using degree columns
initialization.symmetrize_rule: OR (edge present if either direction exists); remove self-loops and duplicates
validate: adoption rate at t0 matches data
network connectivity and clustering within expected ranges
initialization.state_setup: Set mask_state from train_data.csv day 0 if available; else from agent_attributes.initial_mask_wearing
initialization.belief_setup: Initialize risk_perception/trust_authority from agent_attributes; if missing, draw from fitted Beta distributions

algorithms.network_symmetrization: For each agent, for each layer, add undirected edge between i and j if i lists j or j lists i. Remove self loops and duplicates. Validate all-layer union.
algorithms.daily_schedule_and_contacts: For each agent and day, allocate time to home/work_school/public by mix. Effective contacts per layer scale by contact_multipliers. Compute masked neighbor fractions f_L.
algorithms.information_propagation: Compute exposure score s = sum_L w_L * f_L; convert to info probability p_network = 1 - exp(-kappa*s). Combine with exogenous_info_rate and media/governance probabilities to get received_info_t.
algorithms.adoption_update: Logistic decision with parameters {alpha0, phi, gamma_risk, beta_L, psi_info, policy_shift} and innovation/de-adoption rates; draw Bernoulli to set mask_state.
algorithms.policy_enforcement: If mandate at active locations: for non-wearers, with probability enforcement_probability*location.enforcement_strength and budget available, issue fine and set compliance_boost for next d days; update enforcement counters.
algorithms.risk_trust_update: External risk follows bounded random walk around baseline with volatility. Update individual risk via convex combination with external_risk and info signals; update trust slowly via governance/media exposure.
algorithms.calibration: Two-stage: (1) Build/symmetrize network. (2) Fit discrete-time logit/hazard on train_data days 0-29: wear_t ~ wear_{t-1} + risk + f_family + f_work + f_comm + received_info_{t-L} + controls(age_group, occupation). Choose L∈{0,1} by AIC. Tune kappa and layer weights via simulated method of moments to match macro adoption curve and time-to-50%.
algorithms.prediction: Initialize at day 30 with observed states from train_data if provided; else roll forward from day 29. Simulate behaviors days 30-39 using calibrated parameters and realized external risk/media/policy processes.
algorithms.metrics_computation: For days 30-39, compute population adoption rate per day. RMSE = sqrt(mean((predicted - actual)^2)). Peak Adoption Rate Error = abs(pred_peak - actual_peak). Time-to-Peak Error = abs(pred_peak_day - actual_peak_day).
